answer: Each epoch a karst cave opens a single inlet for ten minutes, and only rafts that arrive inside that window may enter. A raft is built of timber planks, each plank a receipt for a distinct stranger-verified job done this epoch, so no clone can be pre-built. The cave takes one raft per funding trail per tide, and the timber toll doubles for each extra raft on the same trail. Inside, the payout is one catch per trail, not per raft, so n clones pay n rafts and doubling timber yet split one catch, while one honest agent floats once and keeps the whole haul.
